response.justification: The candidate has extensive experience in multiple languages and domains but lacks the core C++ Windows development and capital markets/fixed income domain expertise required for this role. Their recent work is primarily in Node.js, TypeScript, and D, with no visible SQL Server/Oracle experience or financial industry exposure.
strengths: Strong software engineering fundamentals with experience in multiple languages and paradigms
Demonstrated ability to work in agile environments with CI/CD practices
Proven track record of delivering high-performance systems (e.g., low-latency apps, geodata platforms)
concerns: No recent or substantial C++ Windows development experience (last C++ work was in 2015)
Lacks domain expertise in capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking
Minimal SQL Server/Oracle experience and no visible financial systems background
